messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: HIGH - sentinel-prod (enterprise) authentication errors spike (OIDC/mTLS). Impact: auth failures to Dedicated Pool A (us-west-2), ~40% of tokens rejected. Escalation to on-call.

oncall-us: Got the page, looking. pulling logs from proxy and authn service.

sre-lead-maya: Noted. @oncall-eu stand by for handoff if we cross timezone. @acct-rcs-julie can you confirm customer is Sentinel (enterprise) and if they rotated anything on their IdP side in the last hour?

acct-rcs-julie: Confirmed - customer says they did a scheduled cert rotation on their IdP at 11:02 UTC. They claim it was a root CA re-sign (cross-sign) and JWKS endpoint updated. They expected no downtime.

oncall-us: Logs show auth proxy TLSServerVerify failures: "tls: certificate signed by unknown authority" coming from our VPC tenant-bridge to their JWKS endpoint. Also lots of 401s from token verifier: "kid not found". Sample logs:

```
2026-03-15T11:10:02Z auth-proxy[pid=1123] ERROR fetch_jwks: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority url=https://idp.sentinel.corp/.well-known/jwks.json
2026-03-15T11:10:07Z token-verifier[pid=204] WARN verify: KID mismatch, none matched in cached JWKS (cache_age=45s)
```

eng-runtime-rohit: Looks like two separate but related failures: (1) our outbound TLS to their JWKS endpoint started failing due to the IdP switching to a CA we don't trust, and (2) tokens already minted with new kid aren't present in our cached JWKS (race while caches warm). Both explain the 40% rejection rate.

sre-lead-maya: Immediate mitigation options (ranked):
  1) Add their new CA to our truststore for the tenant-bridge (fast but needs coordination + short restart of bridge instances).
  2) Temporarily disable strict TLS verification for JWKS fetch on the tenant-bridge for that customer (dangerous, but quick rollbackable).
  3) Bypass our JWKS and use a customer-provided JWKS mirror (they have an internal S3 mirror we could point to).
  4) Force re-fetch and purge cache + fallback to token introspection (if available) which uses server-to-server call to their introspect endpoint.

oncall-eu: Re: 2 — we prefer not to reduce TLS checks. option 1 is safest if we can get their CA cert now.

acct-rcs-julie: I'm on a call with Sentinel now; they're sending the intermediate and cross-signed root bundle. Attaching PEM in the thread once they paste it.

sentinel-paste (via acct-rcs-julie): -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\nMIIF...AB\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----\n(also intermediate cert)

oncall-us: Got the PEM. Preparing to stage truststore update on tenant-bridge instances in us-west-2. Will do minimal rolling restart. ETA 7 mins.

sre-lead-maya: Create a runbook note: rollout only to customer-specific bridge instances (do not modify global truststore). Use canary on one instance, validate JWKS fetch success & token acceptance, then roll remaining.

eng-runtime-rohit: Patch command for canary (example):

```
# copy PEM to /etc/tenant_ca/sentinel.pem
sudo cp sentinel.pem /etc/tenant_ca/
sudo update-ca-certificates --fresh --cert-dir=/etc/tenant_ca/
systemctl restart tenant-bridge-sentinel
```

oncall-us: Canary started on tb-sentinel-01. Observing logs...

oncall-us: Fetch success! auth-proxy log:
"fetch_jwks: fetched 200 OK, jwks_keys=3, cert_chain_verified"

oncall-us: Token verification rate jumped, 401s dropping from 40% to 2% for canary traffic. Rolling to remaining bridges now in 2 waves to limit blast.

sre-lead-maya: Good. While rolling, add cache purge to force new KIDs to be loaded:
```
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/purge_jwks_cache?tenant=sentinel
```

oncall-us: Purge run after canary: caches show new keys present. Metrics trending back to normal for Dedicated Pool A.

solutions-sam: Customer reports their application errors also decreasing, they see internal metrics aligning with ours. They've paused further IdP changes.

acct-rcs-julie: Customer appreciated the quick fix. Asking for a post-incident change control: they want a formal process for future cross-sign rotations.

eng-runtime-rohit: Post-fix action: we'll add support for per-tenant custom trust bundles in the control plane so we can push CA updates without instance restarts (or at least with zero-downtime hot-reload). Also add faster JWKS cache warming on key rotations.

sre-lead-maya: Handing off to @oncall-eu for rest-of-day monitoring and follow-up with customer. oncall-eu please ensure runbook and RCA draft exist.

oncall-eu: Taking over. Will monitor 2 hours, validate metrics (auth success rate, token verification latency), and start RCA doc.

oncall-us: Leaving note — rolling restart windows and PEM copied to /etc/tenant_ca/, command history attached to incident ticket #INC-21495.

sre-lead-maya: Severity downgrade to P2 at 11:56 UTC — customer-facing impact now degraded but functional; no new pages expected. Marking page resolved in PagerDuty.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-21495 status changed to acknowledged -> resolved by oncall-us.

oncall-eu: Observed one small regression during second wave (one bridge missed the new CA due to config drift). I ssh'd and applied patch; verifying now. Will include config drift check in RCA.

eng-runtime-rohit: For the RCA, likely causes:
  - Customer rotated CA and JWKS at same time causing cache mismatch.
  - We lacked per-tenant hot-reload of trust bundles.
  - Inconsistent deployment state for tenant-bridge leads to delayed rollouts.

solutions-sam: Customer requests timeline and recommended mitigation steps. I'll coordinate the external communication and include recommended change control checklist.

acct-rcs-julie: Scheduling a postmortem review with Sentinel and support/engineering next week. They asked for an SLA credit evaluation — passing to finance/growth.

oncall-eu: Last check at 12:35 UTC: auth failure rate steady at baseline <0.5%. Monitoring turned to low-frequency for 2 more hours.

sre-lead-maya: Assign action items:
  - eng-runtime (rohit): add per-tenant trust bundle hot-reload (T+14 days)
  - eng-runtime: add forced JWKS re-fetch + backoff tuning (T+7 days)
  - eng-sre: audit tenant-bridge fleet for config drift + remediation script (T+3 days)
  - solutions: customer comms + runbook update (T+2 days)

oncall-eu: Handoff complete. I'll update INC ticket with notes and leave monitoring alarm with 2hr snooze.

sre-lead-maya: Thanks team. Closing thread here; please add any missing notes to INC-21495.
